title: Ecological Metadata Harvester
subtitle: Automated Ingestion & API Gateway
description: An enterprise-grade full-stack system designed to ingest, validate and manage scientific metadata (Movebank XML and Darwin Core Archives) with database persistence, backend-agnostic ingestion pipelines and DSpace integration.

title: MoveRDM Dataset Explorer
subtitle: MoveRDM Initiative / MPIAB
description: High-performance research data repository frontend built for the MoveRDM initiative, featuring live integration with the Movebank API via Cloudflare Workers, dynamic query building and client-side stream parsing.

title: Spatial-Temporal Migration Playback
subtitle: Movebank Data Repository / Animal Tracking
description: High-performance scientific web application for interactive playback and visualization of animal migration telemetry over geographical map layers, incorporating timeline controls and speed scaling.

title: Multi-Dimensional Sensor Streams Dashboard

description: Modern scientific dashboard designed to visualize multi-dimensional sensor streams, combining GPS tracking with accelerometer and environmental data through synchronized time-series charts.

title: Data Curation & Quality Control Tool
subtitle: Ecological Metadata Management & QC
description: Interactive web utility for researchers working with animal tracking data, featuring automated client-side anomaly detection, data cleaning workflows and high-performance data grids.

title: Bio-Telemetry Spatial Visualizer
subtitle: Advanced Migration Mapping
description: Next-generation spatial rendering engine for migratory animal tracking data, engineered for ecological metadata management and reactive spatial filtering using advanced GIS layers.
